_about: Peer groups that replace the yfinance sector for scoring. Stocks listed here are ranked against each other instead of their sector, and get the normal (non-bank) tests: ROIC, debt, interest cover, free cash flow. Edit freely; the screen rebuilds on the next monthly run. Display and sector filters still use the original sector.

Fee-based financials.reason: Earn fees from payments, exchanges, ratings and data rather than lending, so bank comparisons (P/E ~10-15, no leverage tests) don't fit.
